note: Terrain V2 real-terrain reference tiles (2026-10-10). Centre in NAD83 degrees; the tile is snapped to the NLCD 30 m grid in EPSG:5070 (cell edges at 15 m mod 30) and is size_m on a side. Candidates are previewed first (fetch.py preview). detail: the 1000 m lidar window (fetch.py lidar), metres from the tile centre (x east, y north), picked on the previews.

tiles.why: Central Ohio till plain (Darby Plains, Wisconsinan ground moraine) cut by Big and Little Darby Creek
Wabash River valley below Lafayette, Indiana: terraces, bluffs and tributary ravines cut into the till plain
Illinois Bloomington Ridged Plain: an end moraine (Funks Grove) on flat till plain
Parallel ridges (Blue, Second, Peters Mountain) with long valleys; the Susquehanna cuts water gaps through them
Blue (North) Mountain front against the Great (Cumberland) Valley lowland: mountain to plain transition
Tidal Pamunkey and Mattaponi rivers joining into the York River estuary: marsh, floodplain forest, coastal plain terraces
